text.feels_intro: How {name}'s stab wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a small puncture beads blood near {his} cheek or temple.
{name}'s face: a deep puncture has bled down {his} cheek; the skin around it is already swelling. A faint metallic smell of blood clings to the wound.
{name}'s face: a savage puncture through the cheek or brow; blood floods from it and {his} face is deathly pale. The thick iron smell of blood surrounds {him}.
body: {name}'s back: a small puncture wound weeps a thin line of blood.
{name}'s back: a deep stab wound, steady dark blood soaking {his} clothing around it. The coppery smell of blood seeps from it.
{name}'s back: a deep stab wound into the torso; blood pulses from it and {his} breathing is wet and shallow. {name} smells of blood, heavy and metallic.
arm: {name}'s {part}: a deep stab wound through the muscle, blood running steadily. A coppery tang of blood rises from it.
{name}'s {part}: the arm is skewered through; blood pours and the limb hangs useless. The smell of fresh blood is strong around {him}.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a small puncture in the thigh or calf, oozing blood.
{name}'s {part}: a deep stab wound, blood running down into {his} boot. It gives off the metallic tang of blood.
{name}'s {part}: a deep, bleeding puncture through the muscle; the leg buckles under any weight. The air around {him} is thick with the smell of blood.

head: {name}'s face has a sharp, pinpoint sting. {name} is wary and touches it, flinching at the blood.
{name}'s face throbs hot around the puncture. {name} is shaken and angry, holding {his} head very still.
{name}'s face is blinding pain and pressure; {he} is sick and dizzy. {name} is terrified and can hardly speak.
body: {name}'s back has a sharp, deep sting that catches on every breath. {name} is tense and watchful.
{name}'s back throbs deep inside and every breath stabs. {name} breathes shallowly and moves stiffly.
{name}'s back is a deep, spreading agony and breath is short and wet. {name} is frightened and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} has a sharp, pinpoint sting. {name} protects it and flexes the hand to test it.
{name}'s {part} throbs hard around the stab and goes weak when gripping. {name} cradles it.
{name}'s {part} is deep, burning agony and will not respond. {name} is in shock and cannot grip anything.
leg: {name}'s {part} has a sharp sting with each step. {name} is wary, testing the weight.
{name}'s {part} throbs deep and gives a sharp stab when loaded. {name} limps and winces.
{name}'s {part} is excruciating; it buckles when {he} tries to stand. {name} is panicked and needs help to move.

levels: , a sudden sharp stab. The point punches in and out, and {he} gasps as the pain blooms hot around it.
into a puncture that is already bleeding. The point drives deeper, and the pain flares, sharp and nauseating.
, and the point drives deep into the wound. The pain is huge and wet and {he} chokes on a cry as blood runs. The smell of blood is suddenly thick.
, and it is too much. The stab is crushing and cold; {he} goes ashen, {his} breath rattles and {his} knees give.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

head: the point drives in through {his} eye and deep into the skull; when it comes free, blood and clear fluid run from the hollow socket down {his} cheek. {name} stiffens, twitches and falls, a sharp smell of blood and brain rising from the wound.

the point punches through {his} throat and out the back of the neck; blood bubbles from {his} mouth and from the hole with every failing breath. {name} claws at it, choking on the iron taste, and dies in a wet, rattling gasp.
body: the point drives between {his} ribs and through the heart; blood bursts from the wound in hard spurts and froths pink at {his} lips. {name} stares, gasping, and folds to the ground as the hot smell of blood spreads around {him}.

the point is driven deep through {his} back into the lungs and gut; dark blood and bile seep from the hole, and a sour smell of opened bowel and half-digested food mixes with the iron of blood. {name} drowns slowly in {his} own blood, coughing red, until the last wet breath rattles out.
arm: the point opens the great vessel inside {his} {part}; blood jets out in bright spurts with every heartbeat and the arm goes white and limp. {name} clutches at it, screaming, the smell of blood thick around {him}, until {his} grip slackens and {he} slumps dead in a red pool.

the point tears through {his} {part} at the shoulder and on into the chest; the arm hangs useless while blood pours from both holes. {name} falls gasping, {his} cries thinning to whimpers as the coppery smell of blood fills the air.
leg: the point drives deep into {his} {part} and cuts the great vessel in the thigh; blood spurts in a hot fountain and pools fast beneath {him}. {name} collapses screaming, then turns pale and shaking, and bleeds out in the thick iron reek of {his} own blood.

the point punches through {his} {part} at the groin; dark blood floods {his} clothing and runs over the ground. {name} drags {reflexive} a little way, crying out, and dies there in a widening red pool that smells of blood and fear-sweat.

soil: As {his} body goes slack, the stink of {his} shit and piss mixes with the blood.
In death {his} bowels and bladder let go, and the stench of shit and piss joins the smell of blood.
